posts.preview: Comrade Justina Jonas is a Namibian trade unionist, SWAPO Party Member of Parliament and advocate for workers' rights.
beginnings in Ohadiwa, in northern Namibia, to leadership in the labour movement and the National Assembly reflects a career shaped by workplace experience, trade union organising and public service.

Before entering Parliament in 2025, Cde Jonas served as General Secretary of the Metal and Allied Namibian Workers Union (MANWU), becoming the union's first woman General Secretary in 2012. Her trade union journey began after she joined MANWU as a worker in the construction sector in 1999. She later moved to Windhoe...
Through dedication and experience, she progressed to branch organising and worker education before assuming the union's top leadership position.
